user.title: Swiss Shared Mobility
user.description: Shared bikes, e-scooters and cars from sharedmobility.ch (Swiss Federal Office of Energy).

area.title: Area
area.description: Everything available within the radius ({min}–{max} m). Drag the circle on the map to set location and radius.

station.title: Favorite station
station.description: Search a station of a station-based system by name, e.g. a Mobility car-sharing location or a bike-sharing station.

error.cannot_connect: sharedmobility.ch cannot be reached. Try again later.
error.radius_out_of_range: The radius must be between 100 and 2000 m.
error.no_category: Choose at least one vehicle type.
error.no_results: No station found. Try a shorter or different name.

abort.already_configured: This area or station is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.

data.show_on_map: Show nearest vehicles on the map (max. 50)

error.no_category: Choose at least one vehicle type.

vehicle_count_crossed_threshold.name: Vehicle count crossed a threshold
vehicle_count_crossed_threshold.description: Triggers when the number of available vehicles of an area or a station (all vehicles or one category) crosses the threshold you set.

nearest_vehicle_crossed_distance.name: Nearest vehicle crossed a distance
nearest_vehicle_crossed_distance.description: Triggers when the distance to the nearest vehicle of an area crosses the distance you set, in metres.

vehicles_available.name: Vehicles are available
vehicles_available.description: Passes while at least the minimum number of vehicles is available in an area or at a station.

nearest_vehicle_within.name: Nearest vehicle is within
nearest_vehicle_within.description: Passes while the nearest vehicle of an area is within the distance.

unreachable.title: Swiss Shared Mobility: service unreachable
unreachable.description: The service at {host} has not answered for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the service itself is down. The entities stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

station_missing.title: Swiss Shared Mobility: station no longer reported
station_missing.description: sharedmobility.ch has not reported the station {station} for about an hour. The provider may have removed or moved it. Its sensors stay unavailable. Pick another station with Reconfigure in the entry's menu, or remove the entry; this notice disappears when the station is reported again.
